name: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Scenic artificial lake formed by Mullaperiyar Dam where wild elephant herds gather.

name: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Part of Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve connecting Bandipur and Mudumalai.

name: Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: High tiger density reserve featuring Kannimara Teak, one of the world's oldest teak trees.

name: Thattekad Bird Sanctuary (Salim Ali)
uniqueFeatures: Described by Dr. Salim Ali as the richest bird habitat in peninsular India.

name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Vembanad lakefront wetland roosting ground for migratory Siberian Cranes.

name: Keoladeo Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: UNESCO World Heritage wetlands hosting over 370 bird species.

name: Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Aravalli range sanctuary surrounding historical Kumbhalgarh Fort.

name: National Chambal Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Tri-state river sanctuary protecting critically endangered Gharial and Gangetic Dolphin.

name: Mount Abu Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Sub-tropical forest plateau in Aravalli range rich in orchids and leopards.

name: Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Estuarine mangrove habitat along Mandovi River named after Dr. Salim Ali.

name: Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Dense multi-story Western Ghats forest with observation treetop decks.

name: Netravali Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Crucial Western Ghats corridor connecting Bhagwan Mahaveer and Bhimgad.

name: Bhitarkanika Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Second largest mangrove ecosystem in India, famous for giant Saltwater Crocodiles.

name: Nalabana Bird Sanctuary (Chilika Lake)
uniqueFeatures: Core island sanctuary of Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, hosting over a million wintering waterfowl.

name: Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: World's largest rookery for Olive Ridley Sea Turtles.

visitingHours.accessNotes: Mandatory permits required given the sensitive olive ridley turtle nesting habitat; access is via guided motorboat tours from a limited number of permitted operators. Zones can close on short notice during the annual mass-nesting period (Jan-Feb) and hatching season.

name: Point Calimere Wildlife & Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Ramsar wetland site along Palk Strait, famous for wintering Greater Flamingos.

name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: India's oldest waterbird sanctuary, protected by villagers for over 250 years.

name: Srivilliputhur Grizzled Squirrel Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Created specifically to protect the near-threatened Grizzled Giant Squirrel.

name: Kutch Desert Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Largest sanctuary in India, containing the famous Flamingo City breeding ground.

name: Wild Ass Sanctuary (Little Rann of Kutch)
uniqueFeatures: The sole refuge of the endangered Indian Wild Ass (Khur).

official.label: Wild Ass Sanctuary (Little Rann of Kutch)

name: Nal Sarovar Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Largest wetland bird sanctuary in Gujarat, hosting pelicans, flamingos, and storks.

name: Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Riverine elephant corridor along Cauvery River, sanctuary for Mahseer fish.

name: Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Western Ghats tiger reserve surrounded by Bababudangiri hills.

name: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Ramsar islet sanctuary on Kaveri river near Mysuru, nesting site for Painted Storks.

name: Koyna Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: UNESCO World Heritage Western Ghats reserve surrounding Shivsagar Lake.

name: Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Created specifically to protect the Indian Giant Squirrel (Shekru).

name: Radhanagari Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: First sanctuary in Maharashtra, prime habitat for Indian Bison (Gaur).

name: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Highest density of One-horned Rhinoceroses in the world.

name: Hoollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Sole sanctuary in India named after India's only ape species, the Hoolock Gibbon.

name: Kalatop Khajjiar Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Deodar forest sanctuary near Dalhousie protecting Himalayan Black Bear and Serow.

name: Gulmarg Wildlife Sanctuary
uniqueFeatures: Pir Panjal mountain range sanctuary protecting Musk Deer and Himalayan Monal.
